title: Part One: What Counts, and How It Moves

sections.brief: Definition by organization not identity; the foreign-money ban; American money for a foreign-policy cause; the long record 1990–2012; the frame and its limits.
Six channels: direct PAC, earmarked conduit, super PAC IE and pop-ups, lobbying, charity-sponsored travel, FARA-registered agents. Figures: process; comparison of vehicles.
How to read a number: cycle vs career, for vs against, tracker definitions, snapshot dates; money vs motive (Guardian); scale against other lobbies (Tablet). Figure: data dashboard.
